name: dojo
description: Claude Code plugins: Kaizen (AI-assisted SDLC) and Kaizen Ops (its production commands), Motion Studio (motion design as code) and Slide Studio (presentation decks)

plugins.name: kaizen
plugins.description: AI-assisted SDLC adapted from the Compound Engineering loop: engineering constitution enforced as gates, plan with traceability/threats/rollout/PR-sized slices and independent doc review, test-first work with a Stop-hook quality gate, multi-agent code review, ship & PR watching, UI polish, learnings/ADRs/postmortems read back every cycle, DORA metrics, releases; production commands in kaizen-ops

plugins.name: kaizen-ops
plugins.description: Kaizen's production commands for teams that deploy with Kaizen: watched deployments with typed approval and rollback, production signals and incidents, blameless postmortems. Requires Kaizen core (kaizen@dojo) ≥ 4.0.0, whose CLI and gates it uses

plugins.name: motion-studio
plugins.description: Motion design as code: HTML/CSS/SVG/Canvas animations rendered frame by frame to MP4/WebM/GIF via Playwright + ffmpeg, with synced sound, voice-over and subtitles

plugins.name: slide-studio
plugins.description: Presentation decks as one HTML file: themed template with 19 layouts (ink, paper, kaizen), browser presenter with notes and steps, slide-by-slide layout check, PDF/PNG export
